entities.name: Shaman
entities.description: A creature type of magic users whose power comes from rituals, lore and practice with an emotional and spiritual component.

entities.name: Animists
entities.description: Shamans who can communicate with all parts of land and nature.

entities.name: Flamespeakers
entities.description: A shamanic order dedicated to Purphoros that worships eidolons said to inhabit the volcanoes of Akros.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: The god of the forge worshipped by the Flamespeakers.

entities.name: Shapers
entities.description: Shamans who lead each tribe of the River Heralds, controlling wind, water and jungle.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Tribes each led by a Shaper who shares the name of the tribe's river.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Temur shamans of Tarkir who speak of the frozen memories and spirits of ancestors.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragonlord who ate the Temur clan's whisperers during her rule.

entities.name: Twice Whisperer
entities.description: The Temur's spiritual leader after Atarka's overthrow.

entities.name: Yamabushi
entities.description: The name for shamans on Kamigawa, meaning one who lies in mountains.

entities.name: Delina
entities.description: A Sorcerer character in lore who is typed Shaman.

events.summary: Atarka eats the Temur clan's whisperers during her rule, leaving only hunters; after her overthrow the whisperers return.
events.quote: During her rule, dragonlord Atarka ate the clan's whisperers, leaving only hunters.

relations.quote: Nissa Revane was the last animist of Zendikar .

relations.note: a shamanic order dedicated to him
relations.quote: Flamespeakers are a shamanic order dedicated to Purphoros , the god of the forge.
